scope: Frozen final measurements and arithmetic aggregation only. This export does not replay LLM generation or certify RTL files.
validation: Yosys parse/elaboration/structural checks and exact complete-domain input/output comparison. Unsupported cells use complete-domain Verilog simulation. Saved terminal RTL is independently checked after the generation budget.
truth_table_order: ABC read_truth -xf: line j encodes output bit y[j]. For n-bit unsigned x, zero-based leftmost character index is 2^n - 1 - x.

endpoint_definitions.V: exact full-interface equivalence and fixed Yosys frontend acceptance
endpoint_definitions.H: V plus independently audited word/field structure without input-address answer overrides
endpoint_definitions.V_cost_runtime: all same-case pairs satisfying V in both conditions, irrespective of representation deviations
endpoint_definitions.mean_cost_reduction: 100 * (1 - mean(with_skill) / mean(no_skill)) on the same cases

cost.name: Q
cost.unit: syntax cost units, not dollars or token counts
cost.aggregation: Each comparison uses the same cases for both arms. Percentage reduction is 100 * (1 - mean(with_skill) / mean(no_skill)).

recorded_usage: Token sums include only trials with available completed-turn usage. Missing usage remains blank, not zero. These sums are incomplete and are not a total monetary cost comparison.
generation_timing: Summed per-case durations include model interaction and tool calls, including budget expirations. They are not the elapsed duration of concurrent execution.

representation_annotations.description: Arithmetic RTL contains input-specific answer corrections. These corrections do not disqualify exact RTL from V, but the candidate is excluded from H.
